title: Supply Obtained Outside the Transition Benefit: Effect on a Retail Transition Supply (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, supply that the member obtained outside the transition benefit since the transition window opened is deducted from a retail transition supply. The records read are the member's paper claims and emergency-supply overrides for the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

| Record | Deducted |
|---|---|
| The member's latest paper claim for the drug carries a date of service on or after the transition start date | the days of that purchase not yet elapsed on the handling date: its days supply less the days from its date of service to the handling date, never less than zero |
| No such paper claim, and the member's latest retail emergency-supply override for the drug was granted on or after the transition start date | the days of the override supply not yet elapsed on the handling date: the days supply it allowed less the days from its granted date to the handling date, never less than zero |
| Neither | nothing |

The paper claim governs whenever it qualifies. The override is looked at only when no qualifying paper claim exists. The deduction is taken off the supply before the supply is held between zero and the formulary's maximum for one transition fill.

*Hypothetical (transition start 1 March, handling date 20 March).*
- A paper claim with a date of service of 12 March for 30 days leaves 22 days, and 22 are deducted.
- With no paper claim, an emergency override granted 15 March allowing 7 days leaves 2 days, and 2 are deducted.
- A paper claim dated 25 February is before the window opened, so it is not counted.
